claims.claim: A turn's chaos block makes calls to a named tool fail during that turn
mode error blocks the call; the tool never runs
Model receives "Tool <name> blocked by hook: <message>" as the tool result (runtime pipeline/stage/stages_provider.go:2832)
message appears word for word after the prefix
A blocked call does not count for tools_called (runtime evals/handlers/tools_called.go:154 skips calls with Error)
no_tool_errors fails on a blocked call; tool result message carries chaos_injected: true in metadata (runtime stages_provider.go:2835-2839)
probability fails a share of calls; each call rolled separately; default always fires
trials and pass_threshold on spec / assertions
timeout blocks the call at once like error, with different default text and metadata (chaos_timeout)
slow adds a fixed 2-second delay then runs the tool
Duplex turns ignore chaos (only the pipeline turn executor reads it)
A tool hook can block or delay a call but not replace a real tool's result
mock tools take mock_result or mock_template (runtime tools/types.go:124,128)
